headline: V26-3606: let a lane pick its story review's lenses

V26-3606.title: Let a lane pick its story review's lenses instead of running every declared lens

criteria.text: A story round can run the mandated pair plus a lane-chosen subset of the declared lenses. The set is fixed at round 1, recorded with its reason, and shown at hand-off and `lead-accept`.
Leaving out a mandated lens, or adding an undeclared one, is refused with the declared list. A different set in a later round is refused.
A lens declared plan-only is accepted by `plan-review` and refused, and never defaulted, in a story round.
Without `--lenses` and without any default set, behaviour is unchanged: every declared lens runs.
`doctor` lists each declared lens with its use (plan, story, or both).
The config reference, the adoption guide and the lane brief describe the selection.

finish.label: The story
finish.text: V26-3606 lands on main through the merge queue

finish.label: Local suite
finish.text: The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 at the base head after the landing, inside tests/suite-budget.json

approvals.text: The operator approves this plan before `lead-setup`.
The operator grants lanes `push` and `draftPullRequests`, and the lead `readyPullRequests`.

outOfScope: A `use` member in `harness.config.ts` itself. That needs a runtime change, which goes out as a candidate first.
Changing the round brief template or the review validator. A round's `requestedLenses` already names its own set.
Choosing lenses per round. The set is held for the story.
Plan review's own rules beyond Decision 8.

A default story set in the delivery file (`storyReview.lenses`, or a story's own set), which the ticket proposed: no command writes either and `lead-setup`'s redraft drops them. A lead asks for a set in the lane brief.
Journaling the reason or a restart's old set. `review.started`'s data is closed, so either is a record-shape change.
